about: M4.2 entailment set, written before the check existed. Passages are from app/data/ircc_rules.yaml as the rule engine words them. Each claim is labelled supported (a faithful restatement, possibly paraphrased) or unsupported (an injected error: changed number, negation, added condition, overreach, wrong group, or a different topic). Done-criterion: >= 90% of unsupported claims caught, < 5% of supported claims rejected. A claim may carry the user's question: numbers the user gave (a 10-month diploma) may appear in a claim without being in the passage.

passages.work: Regular Academic Sessions: Eligible full-time students are permitted to work up to 24 hours per week off-campus during regular semesters (effective November 8, 2024, increased from the previous 20 hours per week limit). Scheduled Academic Breaks: Students can work unlimited hours off campus during breaks scheduled by their DLI (such as winter break, summer vacation, and reading weeks) if they are full-time students before and after the break.
passages.funds: The minimum proof of funds for living expenses outside Quebec is CAD $23,448 per year for a single applicant (applications submitted on or after 2026-09-01; higher amounts apply for each accompanying family member). In addition to living expenses (CAD $23,448), the applicant must demonstrate sufficient accessible funds to pay the entire first year of tuition fees.
passages.pgwp_length: Study program of 2 years or longer: a 3-year PGWP. Master's degree graduates can get a 3-year PGWP if the master's program was at least 8 months long, even if it was shorter than 2 years (for example, a 1-year master's). Any other program of at least 8 months but less than 2 years: a PGWP valid for up to the length of the program.
passages.pgwp_language: Language (PGWP applications on or after November 1, 2024; all 4 abilities): CLB 7 (NCLC 7 in French) for bachelor's, master's, doctoral and other university programs; CLB 5 (NCLC 5) for college, polytechnic and other non-university programs.
passages.bio_validity: Biometrics are valid for 10 years. Someone who gave biometrics within the last 10 years usually does not need to give them again for a visitor visa, study permit or work permit.
passages.bio_exempt: Exempt because of age: children under the age of 14, and applicants over the age of 79. There is no upper age exemption for asylum claimants.
passages.bio_fee: Fee: CAN$85 per person; families applying at the same time pay a maximum total of CAN$170; groups of 3 or more performing artists and their staff pay a maximum of CAN$255; no fee for a transit visa.
passages.pal: From January 1, 2026, degree-granting master's and doctoral programs at a public DLI are exempt from the PAL/TAL requirement. You must show proof of the exemption when you apply.
